text:
samir_pm: Quick convo: proposing a new SKU 'Priority Throughput Pass' (PTP) 10 simple bands (50/200/800 RPS), per-route reservation + tail-latency promise. Need input on pricing bands, pilot terms, and launch gates.

nina_eng: Tech feasible. MVP: banded reservations, proxy tag, token-bucket enforcement, basic metrics. Estimate 6-8 weeks.

eli_ops: Ops asks: exhaustion policy, alerting, noisy-neighbor isolation, and a staging harness for 99p tests.

marta_sales: Field prefers banded SKUs, simple invoicing, and a utilization dashboard. Pilot customers want onboarding help.

jon_fin: Bands easier to model. I'll run margin sims; target 35%+ over infra.

kate_legal: Contracts: define "priority", list exclusions, cap credits, pilot addendum. Keep liability limited.

ci-bot: ci-bot: pushed ptp-proxy to staging at 2025-06-02T07:20Z.

samir_pm: Proposed gates: 2 pilots signed, staging 99p pass, console + billing UI, legal pilot addendum. Action owners: Nina=epic, Jon=pricing bands, Kate=pilot T&C, Marta=pilot shortlist, Eli=staging tests. Follow-up Tue 9am PT.
